|os = {{Name|Fishing Treasure Chest}}{{Name|Artifact Trove|3.6%}} |sellprice = 100 }} The '''Ancient Sword''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[Cindersap Forest]] or [[the Mountain]]s, and from [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] or [[Artifact Trove]]s. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. ==Donation== Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Dwarf,Penny,Abigail |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Ancient Sword is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]]. ==Recipes== Ancient Sword is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Ancient Sword is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt034|link=Tailoring{{!}}Green Tunic|class=inline}}. It is a gray dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== Ancient Sword is not used in any [[Quests|quests]]. ==Trivia== The green tunic [[Tailoring|tailored]] from ancient sword and [[cloth]] is similar to the green tunic worn by Link in ''The Legend of Zelda'' series of video games. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Added [[Artifact Trove]] as a source.
